name: Yuvomi
description: Yuvomi is a private, self-hosted family planner - one calm home for everything your household needs to stay organized. No cloud accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking: your data lives on your server and nowhere else. Independent modules - turn on what fits, ignore the rest: - Dashboard - today's tasks, events, meals and reminders at a glance - Tasks - shared to-dos with priorities, due dates and assignees - Shopping - collaborative grocery lists, auto-sorted by category - Meals & Recipes - weekly meal planner with a built-in recipe book - Pantry - what's actually in the house, with storage places and best-before alerts - Calendar - family calendar with recurring events and reminders - Budget - income, expenses, accounts, subscriptions and loans, with shared costs split automatically - Health - vitals, medications, lab results and activity, per household member - Rewards - points on chores, a parent-approved catalogue and an auditable ledger - Inventory - what you own, with warranties and deadlines (off by default) - Housekeeping - chores, supplies and staff/session tracking - Documents - store and find important household files - Notes, Contacts & Birthdays - everything else in one tidy place Why Yuvomi: - Mobile-first PWA - install it on any phone, works offline - Light & dark mode, fast and polished (no bloated frameworks, no build step) - Optional sync - CalDAV / CardDAV, Apple and Google Calendar - OIDC single sign-on for households that already run an identity provider - Encrypted-at-rest storage (SQLCipher) with automated, scheduled backups - Multi-language, fully self-contained and MIT-licensed - Setup - REQUIRED: Set a long random SESSION_SECRET. RECOMMENDED: Set a strong DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY to encrypt the database at rest - without it the database and any synced calendar/contact credentials are stored unencrypted. Generate either secret with: openssl rand -base64 48 After the container starts, open the WebUI - the first visit guides you through creating your admin account. (Headless setups can alternatively run node setup.js in the container console.) Then log in - pick the modules you want and invite your family.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database and stored app data (uploads, documents).

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Destination folder for scheduled and manual database backups.

paths.name: Modules (optional)
paths.description: Optional: drop-in folder for additional Yuvomi modules. Leave default if unused.

paths.name: Documents (optional)
paths.description: Optional: host folder for local document storage. Only used when DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_ENABLED=true. Leave default if unused.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Yuvomi web interface.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: REQUIRED. A long random string used to sign sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: RECOMMENDED. Strong key to encrypt the database at rest (SQLCipher). Leave empty for unencrypted SQLite. Cannot be changed later without re-encrypting. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Affects scheduled backups, reminders, and is the fallback zone for events pushed to Google Calendar.

variables.name: SESSION_SECURE
variables.description: Set to true only when serving Yuvomi over HTTPS behind a reverse proxy. Keep false for direct HTTP access on the LAN.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Use 1 behind one reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/Traefik), or 'loopback' for direct (no proxy) access.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container. Keep default unless you know what you are doing. Legacy /data/oikos.db is auto-migrated on boot.

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Directory inside the container where backup files are written. Must match the Backups path mapping above, otherwise backups fail with a permission error.

variables.name: WEATHER_LAT
variables.description: Optional. Latitude for the Open-Meteo weather widget (no API key required). Find coordinates on openstreetmap.org or Google Maps, e.g. 52.52.

variables.name: WEATHER_LON
variables.description: Optional. Longitude for the Open-Meteo weather widget, e.g. 13.41.

variables.name: WEATHER_CITY
variables.description: Optional. Display name shown on the weather widget, e.g. Berlin.

variables.name: WEATHER_UNITS
variables.description: Optional. Unit system for temperatures: metric (°C) or imperial (°F).

variables.name: OPENWEATHER_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional (legacy). OpenWeatherMap API key to enable the weather widget. Prefer the keyless Open-Meteo variables above.

variables.name: OPENWEATHER_CITY
variables.description: Optional (legacy). City for the OpenWeatherMap weather widget, e.g. Berlin.

variables.name: OPENWEATHER_UNITS
variables.description: Optional (legacy). Unit system for temperatures: metric (°C) or imperial (°F).

variables.name: OPENWEATHER_LANG
variables.description: Optional (legacy). Language code for OpenWeatherMap descriptions, e.g. en, de, fr.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Google OAuth 2.0 client ID for Google Calendar sync.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Google OAuth 2.0 client secret for Google Calendar sync.

variables.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
variables.description: Optional. OAuth callback URL, e.g. https://your-domain.com/api/v1/calendar/google/callback

variables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional Google Drive OAuth client ID override. Leave both Drive overrides empty to reuse Google Calendar credentials.

variables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional Google Drive OAuth client secret override.

variables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_REDIRECT_URI
variables.description: Google Drive Documents callback URL, e.g. https://your-domain.com/api/v1/documents/storage/google-drive/callback

variables.name: OIDC_ISSUER
variables.description: Optional. OIDC issuer URL, e.g. https://authentik.example.com/application/o/yuvomi/

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. OIDC client ID from your identity provider.

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. OIDC client secret from your identity provider.

variables.name: OIDC_REDIRECT_URI
variables.description: Optional. OIDC callback URL, e.g. https://your-domain.com/api/v1/auth/oidc/callback

variables.name: OIDC_TRUST_EMAIL_WITHOUT_VERIFIED_CLAIM
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to allow account linking when your IdP omits the email_verified claim. Only enable if your IdP fully controls email verification and never issues unverified addresses (e.g. older Authentik without an explicit email_verified mapping).

variables.name: APPLE_CALDAV_URL
variables.description: Optional. Apple CalDAV server URL (default: iCloud). Change only if using a custom CalDAV server.

variables.name: APPLE_USERNAME
variables.description: Optional. Apple ID (email) for iCloud Calendar sync.

variables.name: APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. Apple app-specific password for iCloud Calendar sync (generate at appleid.apple.com).

variables.name: SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES
variables.description: Interval in minutes for calendar and contact sync (Google, Apple, CalDAV, CardDAV). Default: 15.

variables.name: BACKUP_ENABLED
variables.description: Optional. Enable automated database backups (default: true).

variables.name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE
variables.description: Optional. Cron schedule for automated backups (default: 2 AM daily).

variables.name: BACKUP_KEEP
variables.description: Optional. Number of backups to retain (default: 7).

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_ENABLED
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to enable automatic upload of backups to a WebDAV server after each local backup.

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_URL
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV server URL, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/username/

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_USERNAME
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV username for authentication.

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV password for authentication.

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_PATH
variables.description: Optional. Remote directory path where backup files are stored (default: /yuvomi/backups/).

variables.name: WEBDAV_BACKUP_KEEP
variables.description: Optional. Number of remote backup files to keep (default: 7).

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_ENABLED
variables.description: Optional. Store newly uploaded document files in the mounted /documents host folder instead of the database. Existing files are not migrated.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH
variables.description: Optional. Container path for local document files. Keep default unless you mounted the documents folder elsewhere.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_ENABLED
variables.description: Optional. Store newly uploaded document files on WebDAV. Existing files are not migrated.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_URL
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV server URL for document storage, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/username/

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_USERNAME
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV username for document storage.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional. WebDAV password for document storage.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_PATH
variables.description: Optional. Remote base folder for document files (default: yuvomi-documents).

variables.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_WEBDAV_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to allow WebDAV document storage on local/private network addresses (e.g. Nextcloud in the same Docker network). Only enable in controlled environments.

variables.name: ICS_SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to allow ICS calendar subscriptions on http:// and local/private network addresses (e.g. a Sonarr/Radarr/Home Assistant feed in the same LAN). Lifts SSRF protection for ICS subscriptions. Only enable in controlled environments.

variables.name: RECIPE_PROVIDER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
variables.description: Optional. Set to true to allow recipe provider (Mealie/Tandoor) mirrors on http:// and local/private network addresses (e.g. self-hosted in the same Docker network). Lifts SSRF protection for recipe provider sync. Only enable in controlled environments.

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: Optional. SMTP server hostname for outgoing email (password-reset links).

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_PORT
variables.description: Optional. SMTP server port (default: 587).

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_SECURE
variables.description: Optional. SMTP connection security: ssl, starttls, or none (default: starttls).

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_USER
variables.description: Optional. SMTP authentication username.

variables.name: EMAIL_SMTP_PASS
variables.description: Optional. SMTP authentication password.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
variables.description: Optional. Sender email address for outgoing mail, e.g. yuvomi@example.com.

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_NAME
variables.description: Optional. Sender display name for outgoing mail (default: Yuvomi).

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Optional but required for password-reset emails to be sent. Absolute origin used to build reset links, e.g. https://yuvomi.example.com. The request Host header is never trusted as a fallback, to prevent reset-link poisoning.

variables.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
variables.description: Optional. Contact URI sent to push services, either a mailto: address or an https: origin, e.g. mailto:admin@example.com. Must be reachable from the internet: Apple rejects a localhost or .local subject with 403 BadJwtToken, which disables push on iPhone/iPad while Android keeps working. Falls back to the SMTP sender address, then BASE_URL, then a placeholder.

variables.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.description: Optional. VAPID public key. Auto-generated on first use and stored in the database when left empty. Set together with the private key to keep existing device subscriptions valid across a redeployment. Generate with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys

variables.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: Optional. VAPID private key. Must be set together with the public key.

variables.name: FIXER_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Fixer API key for live currency conversion in Budget → Subscriptions. Rates are cached for 12 hours; works without this key using the cached/manual rate.
